attributes.description: A bright, tidy warehouse pick hall seen from a raised walkway. Polished grey concrete floor with a green painted robot lane running from the left of the frame to the right. Tall blue and orange pallet racking filled with brown cartons lines the back wall. On the left stands a yellow charging dock with a low orange autonomous mobile robot parked in it. On the right is a steel packing station with a roller conveyor. Nobody is in the hall.
attributes.lighting: Even white high-bay LED light with soft reflections on the polished floor and no harsh shadows.
attributes.view: Static wide view from a raised walkway on the near side, slightly above head height, framing the whole robot lane from the charging dock on the left to the packing station on the right.

attributes.appearance: Low, flat orange autonomous mobile robot with a black top deck, a blue status light strip and four small wheels.

attributes.narrative: The robot's status light brightens and it backs slowly out of the yellow charging dock onto the green lane.
attributes.action: backs slowly out of the charging dock onto the green lane.

attributes.narrative: The robot turns and drives steadily along the green lane from left to right, passing in front of the pallet racking.
attributes.action: drives steadily along the green lane from left to right past the racking.

attributes.narrative: The robot slows as it reaches the packing station and stops beside the roller conveyor, its status light turning green.
attributes.action: slows and stops beside the roller conveyor at the packing station.
